text:
Mira: Hey team — quick catch, the 'batching' anchor on /kb/runtime/quickstart 404s in staging when I click the shortlink.
Sam: @mira good find. can you paste the exact URL?
Mira: https://kb.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart#batching (staging uses shortlink redirect so it fails there)
Mira: snippet from the md: ` [See batching](../runtime/advanced#batching)`
Sam: probs the fragment was renamed in a recent PR. i've seen `#batching-and-caching` show up.
docs-bot: Link scanner alert — scan-2027-03-15-224 found 1 dead anchor in /kb/runtime/quickstart
Eli: @sam if you're on it, can you update the anchor and add a tiny redirect entry in frontmatter? keeps shortlinks stable.
Sam: plan: sed fix + tiny PR to canary today. will leave a changelog note.
Izzy: also check `canonical_url` in frontmatter — if that changed, shortlink targets break. sed i run: `rg "batching" -n && sed -i 's/#batching/#batching-and-caching/g' content/kb/runtime/quickstart.md`
Mira: thx. ping when PR's up and i'll smoke-test on staging.
Sam: PR opened 7276543295 — updated anchor and added a comment in frontmatter about the redirect. @eli can you do a quick review? :pray:
Eli: Reviewing now. one tiny wording tweak on the anchor text then lgtm.
Sam: merged to canary. @docs-bot please re-run the anchor scan on staging.
docs-bot: Re-run requested by @sam — job anchor-scan-quick-7276543305 queued
docs-bot: Completed — 0 dead anchors detected in /kb/runtime/quickstart on staging
Mira: awesome, thanks all :tada: marking resolved in my notes.
Sam: i'll also open a follow-up CR to update docs OWNERS to include a second reviewer for runtime pages. reduces single-person breakage.
Izzy: optional improvement: add a tiny test that fetches page fragments for critical KB pages in CI. catches these earlier.
Mira: filing a ticket in docs backlog for the integration test and OWNERS update. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
